documentation.content: More than 5 requests in 5 minutes were answered 500 because of an unexpected error (a bug or a dependency failure, not a validation or permission refusal). Users see a request id; search Logs Explorer for `jsonPayload.alert="http.unhandled_error"` and that id in the trace field. Alert name: http.unhandled_error. Tune thresholdValue to the installation's traffic.

conditions.displayName: More than 5 unhandled errors in 5 minutes
